run_command: python solution/main.py --help && python solution/main.py doctor --input input
notes: Adapter is complete and ready; on this host the input manifest declares assets_ready=false and none of the required files (upstream/OSTrack tracking scripts and GOT-10k config, mae_pretrain_vit_base.pth, GOT10k/{train,val}/list.txt) are mounted, so `doctor --input input` returns exit 78 and `run`/`resume` refuse to spawn any upstream job. No fake data, no downloads, no CPU fallback, no placeholder model are used. When the assets are admitted, `run` will copy the upstream OSTrack tree into output/worktree, patch the GOT-10k root and MAE weights to point at the read-only input, execute the official train.py with the vitb_384_mae_ce_32x4_got10k_ep100 config (real gradient updates, optimiser and RNG state saved), then execute the official test.py per split with the resulting checkpoint, copy per-sequence trajectories into output/trajectories/<seq>.txt, recompute AO and SR@0.5 from the real val annotations, and write output/run.json with synchronized stage timings and device info. `resume` reuses the latest checkpoint without rebuilding weights for continuation on a new sequence.
